answer_1.quote: We constructed a high-quality bilingual poetry dataset, ModePoem, consisting of 400 modern poems (7,000 lines) in English and their Chinese translations.
answer_1.outputs: Chinese modern poetry translations of English source poems

answer_2.quote: For our automatic evaluation, we used SacreBLEU, BERTScore and COMET to evaluate the performance of different candidate translations.

answer_3.quote: We employed GPT-4 to evaluate various translations based on the human evaluation criteria we established.
methods: LLM-based scoring using GPT-4 with the defined criteria

answer_4.quote: We invited six judges to evaluate the experimental results of eight modern English poems translated under eight different prompts. These judges are Chinese professional poets... We assess candidate translations comprehensively, focusing on eight key aspects, ranging from overall impact to specific details.
answer_4.guideline: Professional poets evaluated translations using a questionnaire that asked them to rate each translation on eight criteria: Overall Impression, Similarity, Fidelity, Line-breaking, Meaningfulness, Poeticity, Accuracy, and Errors.
